questions.q: Tell me about your data entry work. What kind of data did you enter, in which software, and about how much in a day?
questions.looks_for: Real data type (forms, invoices, KYC, orders), the tool used (Excel, ERP, web portal), daily volume, and their own steps.

questions.q: Describe a time you found an error in data, either your own or someone else's. How did you find it and what did you do?
questions.looks_for: Specific error, how it was caught (checking totals, cross-checking source), how it was corrected and reported, and any habit changed after.

questions.q: How do you keep your accuracy high when you have to enter a lot of data fast?
questions.looks_for: Concrete methods: reading carefully, using shortcuts, checking key fields, short breaks, sample self-checks; values accuracy over raw speed.

questions.q: Why is it important to keep data like customer phone numbers, Aadhaar or bank details private, and how do you protect it at work?
questions.looks_for: Misuse and fraud risk, company trust and law; does not share, locks screen, no photos or copies, follows access rules.

questions.q: What is the difference between typing speed and data entry accuracy, and which matters more in your view?
questions.looks_for: Speed is volume, accuracy is correctness; wrong data causes bigger losses so accuracy first, with speed improving over time.

questions.q: You are given 500 forms to enter by evening, and you notice many have unclear handwriting in the phone number field. What would you do?
questions.looks_for: Does not guess; marks unclear ones, continues the rest, informs the supervisor early, follows the agreed rule for doubtful entries, meets the deadline for clear ones.

questions.q: Why do you want this data entry job, when can you join (state your notice period), and what monthly salary do you expect?
questions.looks_for: Clear reason linked to the work, states notice period or joining date in days or weeks, and gives an expected monthly or yearly salary figure or range without dodging.
